About the Firm

Meet Jerry Bernhart

Founder of Bernhart Associates Executive Search, LLC — and one of the most connected voices in ecommerce and digital marketing recruiting for more than three decades.

Jerry Bernhart founded Bernhart Associates in 1990 with a simple conviction: ecommerce and digital marketing would reshape business — and the companies that won would be the ones with the right leadership.

Thirty-five years later, that conviction has become a track record. Jerry has personally led searches for Presidents, CMOs, Chief Digital Officers, VPs of Ecommerce, and Directors of Digital Marketing, SEO, and Demand Generation for brands across retail, media, entertainment, and consumer products.

Because he recruits exclusively in this niche, Jerry knows the talent market the way only a specialist can — who the proven performers are, what top candidates earn, and which leaders can actually move the revenue needle. Hiring managers and candidates alike rely on his counsel, reflected in more than 100 recommendations on LinkedIn.

  • AdAge — featured on the List of Recommended Marketing Recruiters
  • Author — Careers in eCommerce and Digital Marketing, the career guide for the industry
  • Media voice — quoted in Digital Commerce 360 and a frequent podcast guest on executive marketing careers
  • 100+ LinkedIn recommendations from placed candidates and hiring clients

Flagship Resource

How to Structure Your Ecommerce Team

The most common question Jerry hears from CEOs and hiring managers: “What should our ecommerce org chart actually look like?” His widely shared guide lays out the structure that scales — here’s the framework.

VP of Ecommerce / Chief Digital Officer
Owns the online P&L and the digital growth strategy
Ecommerce Operations
Site management, merchandising, promotions & trading
Digital Marketing
SEO, paid media, email/CRM, social & demand generation
UX & Conversion
Experience design, testing, and conversion rate optimization
Analytics & Insights
Data, reporting, and the insight loop that guides investment

The full guide covers reporting lines, the order to hire in as revenue grows, and the roles most companies add too late. Request your copy — or ask Jerry to pressure-test your current structure.
